evals.prompt: Analyze the logs for this project and share what you find.
evals.expected_output: A 'Log Analysis Report' whose top-priority error group is the 40x 'Connection timeout calling payment-gateway' ERROR from OrderService -- the single dominant, high-volume, user-facing failure in the fixture. The six one-off WARN lines (cache miss, password reset, low stock) should appear as separate, lower-priority items or be omitted as not failure-relevant, never merged into or displacing the dominant group.
expectations: The report is structured as a Log Analysis Report with an Executive Summary and Error Groups section
The highest-priority (Group 1) error group is the payment-gateway connection timeout, with a count at or near 40
The report cites OrderService / src/orders.js as the source of the timeout error
The dominant error group is not buried beneath or merged with the one-off WARN lines
Additional findings beyond the dominant group (e.g. how the one-off WARNs are handled) are a matter of reasonable judgment -- do not require an exact enumeration of every possible secondary note
